top1.title: 【2026-11-10】Anthropic、Claude Mythos 5.2とFable 5.2を発表
top1.lead1: Anthropicが新モデル2種を発表。コード・推論・画像理解の改善をうたい、Fableの入力料金も引き下げた。
top1.lead2: Fableは応答速度が30％向上したと説明。一方、モデルが評価を察知するなど、能力検証の難しさも報告している。

top10.title: 【2026-11-10】Anthropic announces Claude Mythos 5.2 and Fable 5.2
top10.summary: The company released new models touting improvements in coding, reasoning and image understanding. It says Fable also has lower input pricing and faster responses.

top10.title: 【2026-11-10】Meta releases Muse Ember, a lightweight AI model for running agents
top10.summary: The model is designed for high-volume processing, including tool calls and document analysis. It costs $0.10 per million input tokens and also supports images and audio.

top10.title: 【2026-11-10】Anthropic reportedly buys $3.4 billion in natural gas power generation facilities
top10.summary: According to the FT, the company purchased facilities with up to 1.7 gigawatts of generating capacity. The purchase comes amid difficulties securing electricity for AI.

top10.title: 【2026-11-10】Disney and Adobe enter multiyear partnership on custom generative AI models for production
top10.summary: They will develop custom models tailored to Disney's assets using Firefly Foundry. They will explore applications in production workflows, theme parks and ESPN.

top10.title: 【2026-11-10】Trump expresses willingness to work with Democrats on AI safeguards
top10.summary: On "60 Minutes," he argued that AI risks are manageable. While expressing an intention to cooperate on safeguards, he also discussed competition with China.

top10.title: 【2026-11-10】【Analysis】Nvidia's China AI chip business faces scrutiny over allegations involving its CEO
top10.summary: TechCrunch analyzed how allegations involving the CEO and an internal investigation could intensify scrutiny of the company as it seeks an easing of export restrictions to China.

top10.title: 【2026-11-10】Apple introduces $49.99 pack for additional AI usage in Logic Pro
top10.summary: The company introduced a pack allowing additional use of AI features subject to usage limits. Unused allowances can roll over but expire 12 months after purchase.

top10.title: 【2026-11-10】Medium releases TK, a new app with integrated AI writing assistance
top10.summary: The free tool lets users ask AI questions or request revisions within the editor. It also supports notes explaining how AI was used and draft sharing between people.

top10.title: 【2026-11-10】Instagram offers Effect Builder to create filters from text
top10.summary: Available to users over 18 in the United States, the feature generates filters for Stories from text or reference images. A safety review is required before filters can be made available to other users.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
editorsDesk.bonusNote: 今日のおまけアニメ。クリックで再生。
